scenes.title: QA that runs the store — not a doc dump.
scenes.body: Story → test cases → quality gate → Manual QA Agent runs → BVA regression → defect pack → perf check. QA only.

scenes.title: Spreadsheets don’t click Buy.
scenes.body: GenAI alone invents ZIPs. TMS never reads the diff. One bot can’t batch, explore, and script PDP. Nobody knows what the run cost.

cards.p: Reads fine. Dies on the real cart total.
No merge findings → no failure tests.
No plain-English run, no risk plan, no $0 PDP script.
No AI ship / no-ship · no $ per op.

scenes.title: AI + CUA on one rail.
scenes.body: Generate and review overlap. Gate proves coverage. Three CUA surfaces plus Playwright BVA. Learning feeds the next prompt. Cost on every call.

scenes.title: Ticket before code. Every row proven.
scenes.body: Full coverage fills gaps. Review bugs become checklist items. Validated learnings ride the prompt — so the next run is smarter.

journey.title: Plain English → live browser.
journey.voice: Tester types intent — agent opens cart, toggles wrap, reads the total. No test author syntax. That’s AI + CUA in one breath.

plan: Click Add gift wrap on line 1

journey.title: Risks no script thought of.
journey.voice: Fake API reply, double Pay burst, refresh with wrap half-saved — exploratory settles with proof or inconclusive, never silent pass.

journey.title: PDP without a model — $0.
journey.voice: Playwright walks option groups: pick non-default metal, reload, add to bag, cart matches PDP, Edit Cart changes group. Pennies of compute, not dollars of tokens.

journey.title: Defect card — you decide.
journey.voice: Nothing auto-files. F1 from review + CUA FAIL + exploratory align — you choose File defect, test problem, or skip.

journey.title: Learning model → rules on prompts.
journey.voice: Free scan picks up QC edits and wrong CUA verdicts. Learning analyse model groups them into rules — you validate once; they ride Generate, review, and CUA prompts with repeat tracking.
rules: Cart/checkout cases state guest vs signed-in and what is in the bag
Never assert subtotal without naming the visible line items
Refresh-after-toggle wrap must match fee on screen
journey.note: LEARNED RULES block capped · same rules next generate run
